# NIPAT Desktop 0.8.5 distribution evidence

## Candidate identity

- Version `0.8.5`, intended channel `stable`.
- Built commit: `eafadf7002a9c7d7c1b9af9ccafc47d698a059e5`.
- [Installer build #70](https://github.com/GregorioDalia/nipat-desktop/actions/runs/41828594202) completed successfully.
- [CI for the built commit](https://github.com/GregorioDalia/nipat-desktop/actions/runs/41828311855) completed successfully.
- [Diagnostics review](https://github.com/GregorioDalia/nipat-desktop/pull/17).
- [Publication review](https://github.com/GregorioDalia/nipat-desktop/pull/18).
- [Technical acceptance record](v0.8.5.json).

The build retains the Windows, Ubuntu, macOS Apple Silicon and macOS Intel installers with their common build identity and checksums. The acceptance record identifies the exact files. A rebuild requires new evidence.

## Scope of the change

Performance diagnostics are optional and can be enabled for a single analysis. They include external container observations, internal counters, phase events and reports. The vendored R scripts and `scientific/SHA256SUMS` are unchanged from 0.8.2. Ordinary runs leave monitoring disabled.

## Checks performed

| Area | Result and scope |
| --- | --- |
| Client | Windows, Linux, macOS ARM64 and macOS Intel CI passed, along with static and documentation checks. |
| Scientific engine | The built image passed regressions for the four analyses, automatic workflows and the display of sample names. |
| Diagnostics | A synthetic DNPcall run produced equal canonical outputs with and without monitoring. The test compared results with expected values and checked for CPU and memory cgroup samples and phase events. |
| Out of memory | Docker confirmed the intentional termination. External measurements were retained and the container was removed. |
| Windows | The checks verified the single installer and embedded Python client in the payload. They did not perform an interactive WSL installation on an end user's PC. |
| Ubuntu | The checks covered installation and analysis as a non-root user, dependencies, reinstallation, removal and upgrade from the previous package. |
| macOS | Native ARM64 and Intel runners checked the PKGs and embedded clients. |
| Joint identity | All four packages correspond to the same commit and scientific archive. The checks verified the evidence and digests. |

The synthetic DNPcall run was brief. The internal monitor collected measurements and the external monitor explicitly reported that it collected no samples. In the separate out-of-memory test, the external monitor collected at least one sample. A missing measurement does not establish zero resource use.

## Outstanding coverage

Complete Lima/Rosetta tests on the target Macs, interactive installation of the candidate on Windows, and large-BAM benchmarks were not performed. Hosted-runner results apply to the configurations tested. The Windows observations in the acceptance record are explicitly historical and do not attest to installation of 0.8.5.

This version introduces measurement tools. The synthetic tests do not establish a speed improvement.
